title: Excellent day with Pamen
text: Excellent personalized tour with LivTours and Pamen.  We were escorted from our hotel. Our guide was professional and personable. She had so many wonderful stories and specifics about the sites that we saw.  She brought us right to the front of the line at the Alkazar and Tower tour. She had wonderful personal insights in to the Cathedral. The time flew that we were together.
author: Eileen

title: An enlightening tour of Seville’s history!
text: Amazing Day! We had a delightful time with Fatima!  She is a wealth of knowledge of the history of Spain and thoroughly explained everything we saw. Had we gone on our own we wouldn’t have understood. We highly recommend this private tour!
author: Trip18223379591

title: Amazing Cathedral and Alcazar experience
text: We booked with LivTours.  Pamen Moreno was our guide and can I just say how wonderful she was!  So knowledgeable and passionate about her city and sharing all of the history of this beautiful place Seville .  Truly worth the experience!  Highly recommend Pam!!
author: Seaside59216124754

title: Sights with a local touch
text: Our guide, Beatriz, was great! She had exceptional knowledge about the art and architecture at each location. Within the tour she sprinkled in context from her experience living in Sevilla. Would recommend!
author: clairecJ3050BL

title: Must see and do in Sevilla
text: Clara was a wonderful guide on a visit that should not be missed in Sevilla!
author: R6520SPmichellep

title: Amazing tour of Seville's sights!
text: We spent a wonderful morning with Beatriz touring the Alcazar, Seville Cathedral and Giralda Tower. Beatriz is a wonderful tour guide and made our visit to Seville very special. She made history interesting by sharing insights into the backstories of the sights. She cared about what my teenage kids found interesting and found ways to make the Alcazar and Cathedral interesting for them. I would highly recommend this tour with Beatriz!
author: 115janellei

title: Amazing - Would come back just to have another tour with Fatima!
text: Fatima was EXCELENT!  She made the city come alive and thrilling even in 40 °C heat.  Her knowledge and love for Seville are unmatched.  She even managed to keep my 6- and 8-year-olds engaged and interested!  I couldn’t imagine having another guide
author: DustinC590

title: Great experience with Clara!
text: Clara was a great tour guide and gave a lot of color to the experience and the city. We really enjoyed the tour, would recommend!
